SELECT fb.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, fb.saved_at AS savedAt
FROM favorite_benefit fb JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_no = fb.benefit_no JOIN benefit_category bc ON bc.category_code = b.category_code
WHERE fb.member_no = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY fb.saved_at DESC, fb.favorite_no DESC
